items.headline: BepiColombo spacecraft set to enter orbit around Mercury after an eight-year journey
items.summary: After an eight year journey through the solar system, the European and Japanese BepiColombo spacecraft is scheduled to enter orbit around Mercury on November twenty-first. Its instruments, including an X ray spectrometer that already passed its first in-space tests, will spend the coming months studying the sun's innermost planet before full science observations begin next spring.
items.why_it_matters: It is only the second mission ever to orbit Mercury, giving scientists their first fresh look in over a decade at the composition and magnetic field of the solar system's least explored rocky planet.
